# Loops

Source: [`Kernel/Loops.wl`](../../Kernel/Loops.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#loops-kernelloopswl--buildloopintegrands)

BuildLoopIntegrands: the one-loop integrand of d\_s Gamma2\_ab(nu, p) at fixed loop frequency and momentum (w, q), d\_s Gamma2\_ab(nu, p) = Int dw/(2 Pi) d^dq/(2 Pi)^d { Tr\[d\_sR G(w,q) Gamma3\_a(nu,p;w,q) G(w+nu,p+q) Gamma3\_b(-nu,-p;w+nu,p+q) G(w,q)\] - 1/2 Tr\[d\_sR G(w,q) Gamma4\_ab(nu,p;w,q) G(w,q)\] }, with the 1/(2 Pi) of the w-measure included and Int d^dq/(2 Pi)^d left to the numerics. The formula is hand-derived in docs/MODULES.md section "Loops" (E3/E4: not independently tested).

## Symbols

### `BuildLoopIntegrands`

`BuildLoopIntegrands[vertices, prop, regulator]` returns the "Loops" stage; `LoopIntegrand[loops, {a, b}, nu, p]` is the integrand of d\_s Gamma2\_ab(nu, p) (leg a at (nu, p), leg b at (-nu, -p)) at loop point (w, q) = `LoopVariables[loops]`.

### `LoopIntegrand`

`LoopIntegrand[loops, {a, b}, nu, p]` is the integrand of d\_s Gamma2\_ab(nu, p), with abstract d\_s R entries `dsR[c, d]`.

### `LoopVariables`

`LoopVariables[loops]` = {w, q}: the loop frequency and the loop momentum (a vector symbol) used by LoopIntegrand.
